th 07/Dated: 08 January, 2025 I.A. No. 10101 of 2023:
1. We have heard the learned counsel for the parties.

2. This Court has been confronted with a very peculiar circumstances in the present case wherein an orphan girl has been subjected to rape and she has also been disclosed to be not of sound mind living at the railway station.

3. The present appellant has been convicted on the basis of the charge having been proved that the appellant has facilitated in commission of rape of the victim (orphan girl).
4.
This Court has posed a pin pointed query that as to whether FIR has been instituted against the person concerned who has committed the rape.

5. Learned Additional Public Prosecutor appearing for the respondent- Gita Biruli vs The State Of Jharkhand on 8 January, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/64270868/
1

sentences.text:
State has submitted that he is not aware of the same and he has submitted by referring to paragraphs-116 and 138 of the case diary wherein it has been recorded that no clue has been found with respect to the person concerned who has committed rape upon the victim and the moment any clue will be found, further investigation in the matter will be started.
6.

This Court, in view thereof, is of the view that when the prosecution version is based upon the commission of rape resulting into delivery of a female child, hence, the main perpetrator of the commission of crime needs to be dealt with.

7. It needs to be referred herein by taking note of the prosecution version that against the appellant the specific allegation which has been proved is that she used to send the victim before the person concerned who has committed the rape and based upon that the appellant has been convicted for the commission of offence under Section 376/109 of IPC and under Section 370 of IPC.
8.

The question which arises is that when the very basis of the charge having been proved against the present appellant is that she used to send the victim to the person concerned for sexual exploitation then under which circumstances the investigation has been conducted without taking note of the person concerned before whom the victim was used to be send for sexual exploitation.

9. Let the S.P., Chaibasa explain the same.
10.Learned Additional Public Prosecutor has also sought for time to seek instructions from the S.P.,
Chaibasa on the aforesaid issue.

12. Let this case be listed on 13.01.2025.
13.

Learned Additional Public Prosecutor is directed to communicate this order orally to the S.P.,
Chaibasa.

(Sujit Narayan Prasad, J.) (Navneet Kumar, J.) Saurabh/-
